id: title:MattPua:reuse dashboard skeleton on shared pages

review.posthog_relevance: Adds configurable loading state and tile placeholders to the Dashboard Exporter, replacing a generic fallback.
review.reason: The change replaces a static fallback with a configurable `DashboardLoadingState` component, allowing the dashboard export to render specific tile placeholders and optional controls. This is a localized UI behavior improvement.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to the dashboard export loading experience; no broader systemic or backend changes are demonstrated. The score is not multiplied by the number of hunks or PRs.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds DashboardLoadingState component and its props, replacing a static fallback with a configurable loading state.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Exporter to render a loading state with optional controls and tile-specific placeholders, rather than a generic scene skeleton.

observations.behavior: Replaces the fallback for the dashboard loading state with DashboardLoadingState, passing tile count and no controls.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the loading behavior of the dashboard export to use the new configurable loading state instead of the previous scene-specific skeleton.

observations.behavior: Adds props showControls and tileCount to DashboardLoadingState, and conditionally renders the controls section.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the loading state to omit dashboard controls and render a specific number of tile placeholders, supporting the export use case.
